READ	SELECT ifnull(null, 'x'), ifnull('y', 'x'), ifnull(null, null)
READ	SELECT nullif('x', 'x'), nullif('x', 'y')
READ	SELECT nvl(null, 'x'), nvl('y', 'x'), nvl(null, null)
READ	SELECT nvl2(null, 'x', 'y'), nvl2('n', 'x', 'y'), nvl2(null, null, null)
READ	SELECT ifnull(1, 2.1d), ifnull(null, 2.1d)
READ	SELECT nullif(1, 2.1d), nullif(1, 1.0d)
READ	SELECT nvl(1, 2.1d), nvl(null, 2.1d)
READ	SELECT nvl2(null, 1, 2.1d), nvl2('n', 1, 2.1d)
READ	SELECT boolean(1), tinyint(1), smallint(1), int(1), bigint(1)
READ	SELECT float(1), double(1), decimal(1)
READ	SELECT date("2014-04-04"), timestamp(date("2014-04-04"))
READ	SELECT string(1, 2)
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW tempView1 AS VALUES (1, NAMED_STRUCT('col1', 'gamma', 'col2', 'delta')) AS T(id, st)
READ	SELECT nvl(st.col1, "value"), count(*) FROM from tempView1 GROUP BY nvl(st.col1, "value")
READ	SELECT nullif(SUM(id), 0) from range(5)
